section_summary: This page opens a strictly confidential despatch concerning attempted shipments of contraband metals to Japan. It summarizes information from earlier embassy communications and the American consuls at Manzanillo and Tampico, then begins reproducing Manzanillo customs statistics for metals transported there in two boxcars.

subfiles.title: Attempted Shipments of Contraband Metals to Japan
subfiles.about: The despatch summarizes reports about attempted shipments of contraband metals to Japan through Mexican ports.
subfiles.summary: The embassy refers to its telegram No. 542 of October 18, 1941, and earlier communications concerning attempted shipments of contraband metals to Japan. It combines those reports with information obtained from American consuls in Manzanillo and Tampico. The page begins repeating Manzanillo customs statistics on metals carried in two boxcars to the port, previously reported in Vice Consul despatch No. 20 of October 29, 1941.
